test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: The primary function of microfinance institutions, according to the passage, is to:

options.text: Charge high interest rates to rural borrowers
Offer financial services to those excluded from traditional banking system

solution: The correct answer is **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) primarily provide financial services to individuals who are excluded from the traditional banking system, especially in rural areas. (परंपरागत बैंकिंग प्रणाली से बाहर रहने वाले व्यक्तियों को वित्तीय सेवाएँ प्रदान करना) • They extend small loans and savings accounts to empower entrepreneurs, often women, to start or expand microenterprises. • MFIs also offer financial education to help borrowers manage cash flows and interest charges, promoting financial literacy and inclusion. • Thus, the core function is not about charging high interest, providing large corporate loans, or regulating national monetary policy. Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Option 1:** Charge high interest rates to rural borrowers (ग्रामीण उधारकर्ताओं से उच्च ब्याज दर वसूलना) – This is a criticism sometimes associated with MFIs, not their primary function. • **Option 2:** Provide large corporate loans (बड़ी कॉर्पोरेट ऋण प्रदान करना) – MFIs focus on microloans, not corporate financing. • **Option 4:** Regulate national monetary policy (राष्ट्रीय मौद्रिक नीति का नियमन करना) – This is the role of central banks, not MFIs. 3f:Tb78, The correct answer is **Option 2**.
